leanne_sales: Aurora POC tomorrow AM. Needs streaming SDK + model-initiated synchronous webhook calls (model must wait), strict edge validation of invoice JSON, customer KMS, and fixed egress/VPC. Also wants Hosted vs Dedicated cost breakdown and an on-call for the demo. Can someone bring a tiny SDK sample (not Node this time) and a 1-page runbook?

omar_presales: Copy. Quick Qs: expected burst patterns? any long tail responses? Do they want retries for webhook failures or the model to return an error envelope?

leanne_sales: Burst to 100 qps for short windows, baseline ~50 qps. Avg ~100 tokens/resp. Tool calls ~15% of responses. Prefer model to block and surface a structured error if webhook fails; retries ok but prefer deterministic behavior for POC.

violet_devrel: I'll bring a tiny Go demo this time (gives different ops flavor). Example (pseudo):
```go
// pseudo Go streaming + sync function call
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"), redwood.WithRouting("dedicated"))
stream := client.Stream(context.Background(), redwood.StreamOpts{Model: "redwood-rtf-1", Functions: []Function{InvoiceFn}})
for ev := range stream.Events() {
  switch ev.Type {
  case redwood.EventFunctionCall:
    resp, err := http.Post(ev.Call.Webhook, "application/json", bytes.NewBuffer(ev.Call.Args))
    if err != nil { stream.ResumeWithError(err.Error()); break }
    var j map[string]interface{}; json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&j)
    stream.ResumeWithFunctionResult(j)
  case redwood.EventDelta:
    fmt.Print(ev.Delta)
  }
}
```
Edge validation rule: require top-level "invoice" object with invoice_id (string), total_cents (integer), currency (string), and line_items array of objects {desc:string, qty:integer, unit_cents:integer}. If validation fails -> return {"_error":"schema_mismatch","details":...} and route to human review.

sam_ops: Ops notes: for p50 <120ms use Dedicated routing + small batch sizes (max_batch_size=4-6) and aggressive KV prefix caching. For short bursts we can enable burst-hosting fallback (auto-burst to hosted pool) but need to ensure VPC egress behaviour — bursts will come from hosted IPs unless using Private bump. Webhook guidance: set client timeout 1200ms and circuit-breaker with concurrency limit of 10 per webhook to avoid queueing.

omar_presales: Pricing POV: Hosted raw token math vs Dedicated commit. For this footprint (50-100 qps, ~100 tokens) estimate hosted cost is high; Dedicated baseline / reserved node pool mid-five-figures/mo. Recommend hybrid: commit for baseline, allow hosted burst. I'll DM a two-line ballpark for the call now.

leanne_sales: Great. @violet_devrel can you push the Go demo + a tiny Python smoke script (for customers) into the presales repo? @sam_ops drop SOC2 + KMS checklist in the deal folder and flag any network lead time. I'll schedule the demo and tell them we'll show the live mock webhook with schema validation. :rocket:
